Name: Part Restoration Unit
Description:
[h2]Part Restoration Unit[/h2]

Ever opened object storage and found enough damaged arms, legs, sockets, and questionable organs to assemble one extremely unlucky crew member? Well, have I got a medically overqualified workbench for you!

Part Restoration Unit adds an automated medical-industrial facility that restores the Condition of detached biological and robotic body parts. Powered idle units queue eligible damaged parts automatically, or you can select loose parts and order Repair yourself. Ordinary haulers and available Nanobot Hives can carry the exact reserved part into the unit.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[h3]Automatic Part Restoration[/h3]
- Queues the first eligible damaged body part found in object storage
- Preserves the exact physical part from reservation through repair and ejection
- Repairs biological and robotic body-part Condition without an operator
- Ejects the restored part for normal storage, hauling, or other eligible tasks
- Suspends ordinary detached-part decay while the part is loaded in the unit

[h3]Nanobot Hive Delivery[/h3]
- Allows working Nanobot Hives to deliver queued loose or stored parts into the unit
- Respects the Nanobot Hauling job, Hive power and fuel, range, and reachable area
- Requires the Hive to reach both the part and the Part Restoration Unit
- Preserves an in-flight delivery across save and reload
- Coordinates with Quantum Storage so one Hive is not assigned to both systems
- Remains one-way: completed parts leave through the normal output and return to ordinary automation

[h3]Per-Unit Controls[/h3]
- Automatic Intake toggle, enabled by default
- Biological only, Robotic only, or Biological and robotic intake filter
- Power-aware intake that does not pull new work while the unit is unavailable
- Detailed Overview status for searching, hauling, repairing, power, and eligibility
- Live Condition display with the maximum ceiling Core currently permits

[h3]Manual and Batch Repair[/h3]
- Adds a green Health-icon Repair action to eligible selected body parts
- Works with single selections and large multi-selections
- Ignores non-body-part objects in a mixed selection
- Assigns eligible parts only to currently available units
- Manual Repair remains available independently of each unit's automatic-intake filter

[h3]Upgrades and Automation[/h3]
- Accepts Speed Upgrades and Energy Efficiency Upgrades
- Requires no operator and grants no job experience
- Uses Core's Crafting Station automated-arm animation without copying Core animation assets
- Adapts its storage search timing so idle fleets do not perform unnecessary full scans

[h2]Condition, Not Quality[/h2]
Part Restoration Unit repairs Condition only. It never changes Quality and never bypasses permanent surgical damage. If Core limits a crippled part to 50% maximum Condition, the unit finishes at that ceiling instead of becoming stuck waiting for an impossible 100%.

[h2]Research[/h2]
Part Restoration is a Tier 3 research node requiring Medical Care and Maintenance.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
The mod remains independently usable. Optional read-only compatibility contracts coordinate with Auto Hauling and Intelligent Recycling when those maintained mods are installed, without adding hard dependencies or overriding unrelated third-party automation. When Quantum Storage is installed, optional runtime coordination prevents double-assignment of Nanobot Hives without creating a dependency. Shared consumer compatibility infrastructure is provided by Auto Utilities Mod Framework.

[h2]Requirements[/h2]
Requires Stardeus 0.15.0 or later and Auto Utilities Mod Framework 1.4.0.

[h2]In Short[/h2]
You choose what each unit accepts. Haulers or Nanobot Hives move the part. Part Restoration Unit restores it as far as Core allows.

[b]Same part. Better Condition. No Quality miracles.[/b]
